 This appeal coming on for judgement this day, the Court  following:
 JUDGEMENT

This appeal has been filed by the appellant/accused person under section 71(6) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 being aggrieved by the order dated 23.09.2019 passed in M.C.A No.36/2018 passed by the District Judge, Food Safety Appeal Abhikaran, District-Dhar.

2. Learned counsel for the State submitted that report dated 31.12.2023 is received from S.H.O.,
Dhar and as per the report appellant no.1 Taiyyab Ali S/o Akbhar Ali Bohra, died on 24.04.2021.
The report is supported by death certificate.

3. Learned counsel for the appellant also submitted that sole proprietor Taiyyab Ali (appellant no.1)
of firm Saifi Kirana Store has been died therefore, appeal has been abated.
